SCRIPTURE GUILD — SOCIAL SHARE IMAGE INSTRUCTIONS
==================================================

File to create: og-image.jpg
Placement: public/og-image.jpg
Required size: 1200 × 630 pixels
Format: JPG (preferred) or PNG
Target file size: Under 300 KB


PURPOSE
-------
This image appears automatically when someone shares a Scripture Guild
link on WhatsApp, Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Telegram, iMessage,
Slack, or Discord. It is the first visual impression of the platform.


VISUAL BRIEF
------------
Concept: Modern Bible Study meets Sacred Atmosphere

Main elements to include:

  1. FOCAL POINT — An open Bible, beautifully lit, resting on a warm
     wooden desk. The pages are glowing softly with golden light as if
     the words themselves radiate warmth and truth.

  2. LIGHT EFFECT — Soft, cinematic golden/amber light rays rising
     gently from the open pages upward. Can include subtle light
     particles or a gentle glow diffusing across the scene.

  3. TECHNOLOGY ELEMENT (optional but recommended) — In the background
     or to one side, a modern tablet or laptop screen showing a clean,
     dark-navy UI that represents the Scripture Guild platform. This
     connects the sacred with the modern digital experience.

  4. TEXT OVERLAY — Two lines of text, centered or left-aligned:

       Scripture Guild
       Understand God's Word Deeply

     Font style: Elegant serif (Georgia, Playfair Display, or similar)
     Scripture Guild — bold, large, warm gold (#f0c040)
     Subtitle — lighter weight, cream/white (#f5f0e8)

  5. OPTIONAL ACCENTS:
     - A subtle gold cross in one corner
     - Faint ancient parchment texture behind the Bible
     - A small Scripture Guild logo (📖) watermark in the bottom corner


COLOUR PALETTE
--------------
  Deep Navy (background / shadows)   #0d1f3c
  Warm Gold (highlights / text)      #f0c040
  Soft Cream (subtitle text)         #f5f0e8
  Warm Amber (light rays)            #e8a020
  Dark Wood (desk surface)           #3d2010


THREE DESIGN DIRECTIONS TO CHOOSE FROM
---------------------------------------

Direction 1 — MODERN BIBLE STUDY (Recommended)
  Open Bible + faint laptop/tablet showing Scripture Guild UI in BG
  Clean, professional, trustworthy
  Best for LinkedIn and Facebook

Direction 2 — SPIRITUAL & CINEMATIC
  Close-up of Bible pages with dramatic golden light rays bursting
  upward. No technology — purely sacred atmosphere.
  Emotional, reverent, shareable on WhatsApp

Direction 3 — COMMUNITY LEARNING
  Young believers (diverse group) gathered around a table with open
  Bibles and a tablet. Warm natural light. Joyful expressions.
  Best for broad social appeal and relatability

RECOMMENDED: Mix Direction 1 + Direction 2 — open Bible with golden
glow AND a hint of the modern UI in the background.


HOW TO CREATE THIS IMAGE
------------------------
  Tools you can use (all free or low-cost):

  • Canva (canva.com) — search "Bible study" templates, resize to
    1200×630, add your text and branding

  • Adobe Express (express.adobe.com) — free tier available,
    excellent for social media graphics

  • Figma (figma.com) — free design tool, create a 1200×630 frame,
    use royalty-free images from Unsplash

  • DALL·E / Midjourney / Adobe Firefly — AI image generation.
    Prompt suggestion:
    "An open Bible glowing with warm golden light on a rustic wooden
    desk, soft cinematic lighting, ancient parchment texture, deep
    navy and gold colour palette, modern tablet visible softly in
    background, reverent and peaceful atmosphere, photorealistic,
    16:9 aspect ratio"

  • Unsplash (unsplash.com) — search "Bible study" or "open Bible"
    for free high-quality base photos to overlay text on


AFTER CREATING THE IMAGE
------------------------
  1. Save as og-image.jpg (quality 85–90%)
  2. Place in the public/ folder: public/og-image.jpg
  3. Update index.html with your real domain:
     Change: content="https://www.scriptureguild.com/og-image.jpg"
     To:     content="https://YOUR-ACTUAL-DOMAIN.com/og-image.jpg"
  4. Run npm run build
  5. Deploy dist/ folder
  6. Test your Open Graph tags at:
     • https://opengraph.xyz
     • https://developers.facebook.com/tools/debug/
     • https://cards-dev.twitter.com/validator


QUICK TEST AFTER DEPLOYMENT
----------------------------
  Copy your live URL and paste it into WhatsApp or Telegram.
  You should see the preview card appear immediately with your
  image, title, and description.

  If the old image still shows (cached), use the Facebook Debugger
  or Twitter Validator above to force a cache refresh.


"Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path."
— Psalm 119:105
